points.description: Names the two modes of control plane distribution: replication and partitioning.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one mode is named correctly.

points.description: Gives one valid downside for each mode: replication (e.g. scalability issue, extra cost/resources, idle standby wastes resources, hard to keep replicas consistent); partitioning (e.g. P2P-like issues, need neighborhood knowledge, coordination/consistency problems, lower availability).
points.partial_credit: Half if a valid downside is given for only one mode.

rubric.notes: Full marks: both modes (replication, partitioning) named, each with one reasonable downside from the model answer, in any wording. Give part marks if only one mode or one downside is correct, or if downsides are given vaguely. No marks for unrelated answers; extra remarks are not penalised.
